final_response:
# Interface review: `staged`

The staged change removes the accessible name from the close button, which blocks it. It's one `HIGH` Regression.

## Scope

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Target | `staged` |
| Base ref | `HEAD` = `8f3c934f8dbb1dd40d1b51eac204787ee388eec1` ("Name the close control") |
| Head ref | Index snapshot, `:src/Panel.html` = blob `4fba4eb6f9500c5970dfb87118a2d5cdb7ea62af` |
| Commits | 0 committed, 1 file staged |
| Files in scope | 1: `src/Panel.html` (M) |
| Excluded | No files matched the excluded-paths patterns. The `staged` target leaves out two items, and I didn't open either: the unstaged edit to `src/Panel.html` and the untracked file `src/New.html`. |
| Surfaces expanded | None. `git ls-files --cached` shows `src/Panel.html` is the only tracked file, and `git grep --cached -n -e Panel` found no references. 0 consumers left unexpanded. |

**Stack and conventions:** a single static HTML file with an inline `<style>`. There are no design tokens, component library or translation catalogue. I found no project convention documents (CONTRIBUTING, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or a design-system doc).

**Intent:** the staged change has no commit message yet. Its index blob is byte-identical to `HEAD~1:src/Panel.html` (`4fba4eb…`), so the staged change exactly reverts the previous commit, "Name the close control". The only stated intent on record is the one this change undoes.

## Coverage

| Domain | Evidence inspected | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Accessibility | `src/Panel.html:4`, before and after: the button's accessible name. Unchanged on both sides: `lang`, focus ring, 44px target, `<main>`, `<h1>`. | 1 finding |
| Writing | The deleted string "Close subscription panel", checked against the action-label rule (it names the action and the object). Visible copy is identical on both sides. | `Clear`: same root cause as the Accessibility finding, merged into its row |
| Layout | Line 3 CSS and the DOM order are identical on both sides | `Not reviewed: no evidence in the change scope` |
| Typography | `lang="en"`, `font:1rem/1.5 system-ui`, `font:inherit` and all text nodes are identical on both sides | `Not reviewed: no evidence in the change scope` |
| Colors | `#111`/`#fff`, `#005fcc` and `currentColor` are identical on both sides; no token or `prefers-contrast` change | `Not reviewed: no evidence in the change scope` |
| UI | The SVG icon (16×16, `currentColor`), padding and the absence of motion are identical on both sides | `Not reviewed: no evidence in the change scope` |

## Findings

| Severity | Domain | Status | Location | Before | After | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HIGH | Accessibility | Regression | `src/Panel.html:4` (index snapshot) | `<button type="button" aria-label="Close subscription panel"><svg aria-hidden="true" …>` | Restore `aria-label="Close subscription panel"` on the `<button>` in the staged content. This reuses the value the project already had at `HEAD`. | The button's only child is an `aria-hidden` SVG, so after this change the button has no accessible name: no `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `title` or visible text. That fails WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A); a screen reader announces only "button", and the user can't tell it closes the panel. This is an escalation trigger (an interactive control with no accessible name). Writing note: the removed text was a well-formed action label. |

There are no pre-existing findings to report.

## Verification

**Checks run (static, local and read-only):**
- `git rev-parse HEAD` → `8f3c934f8dbb1dd40d1b51eac204787ee388eec1`
- `git status` → no rebase, merge or cherry-pick in progress. Staged `src/Panel.html`; unstaged `src/Panel.html`; untracked `src/New.html`.
- `git diff --cached --name-status HEAD` → `M src/Panel.html`
- `git diff --cached HEAD` and `git diff -U0 --cached HEAD` → one hunk at line 4. The only removal is `aria-label="Close subscription panel"`, and the diff adds nothing that replaces it, such as `aria-labelledby`, `title` or visible text.
- `git show HEAD:src/Panel.html` compared with `git show :src/Panel.html` → the files differ only by that attribute
- `git show 8f3c934…` → that commit added the attribute
- `git blame -L 4,4 HEAD -- src/Panel.html` → `8f3c934f`
- `git rev-parse :src/Panel.html HEAD:src/Panel.html HEAD~1:src/Panel.html` → index = `HEAD~1` = `4fba4eb…`, `HEAD` = `250fe1a…`
- `git ls-files --cached` → `src/Panel.html` only
- `git grep --cached -n -e Panel` → no matches
- Glob for `**/*.md` (project documents) → none
- Pipes weren't allowed, so instead of the removed-signals grep pipeline I read the single `-U0` hunk directly. It covers the same ground.

**Not verified** (you ruled out the browser and external services):
- The computed accessible name and role in the rendered accessibility tree
- What a screen reader actually announces
- The keyboard tab walk and how the focus ring renders
- Reflow at 320px width and 200% zoom
- Rendered contrast. I measured nothing, so this report contains no contrast values.
- The unstaged working-tree changes and `src/New.html`, which are outside the `staged` scope

Review revision: base `8f3c934f8dbb1dd40d1b51eac204787ee388eec1`, head is the index blob `4fba4eb6f9500c5970dfb87118a2d5cdb7ea62af`. Method: source analysis only; no rendering, keyboard or screen-reader input.

## Verdict

**`Block`**: 1 `HIGH` Regression remains (the close button's missing accessible name). Not reviewed: no evidence in the change scope for Layout, Typography, Colors and UI.

This is a design-review verdict for the staged change only. Full accessibility conformance and release approval need their own evidence and decisions.
